name: Niijima Gaku
source:
Star Sign: Leo
Ruby of the 'Jewel Five'.
2nd year high school student, black magic course.

A black magic student with red eyes and a dangerous aura.
A curious hedonist with a seriously sharp tongue and ill-temper.
He loves music, especially rock and it shows in how he dresses.
He also loves reading and surprisingly gets along with Hakuya.
He also loves gourmet food and is good at sports.
